caption: The drawing features two distinct objects positioned vertically on a plain, light beige background. The object at the top is a small, brown metallic iron shaped like a duck, with the handle forming the upper part of the duck and the body detailed with feather-like engravings. Below this, there is a trivet, also brown metallic in appearance, with three short legs and an open, decorative design on its flat, triangular surface. The composition is simple, with both objects depicted with careful attention to their shapes, textures, and metal surfaces, and they are spaced apart from one another on the page. The artist's name, "LILLIAN R. HUNTER," is printed in small capital letters in the lower left corner.
title: Toy Iron
